items.text: Area prophecy blogger confirms Antichrist is still anyone with a headset mic, pending election results.

items.text: Blood moon deemed prophetically adjacent after cloud cover forces conference to pivot to PowerPoint.

items.text: This-generation calculator issues patch: now counts biblical years, prophetic years, and years that feel like it.

items.text: Local family sells remaining assets before the Rapture, immediately discovers Rapture shipping is nonrefundable.
